components.basis: The rule sheet sheet:hilbert-fol, rendered once on route by \showcalculus{hilbert-fol} at classical-and-constructive-calculi.tex:176, displays the axiom schemas A1-A3 (lines 11-13), forall-1 (15), forall-2 with x not free in the antecedent (16) and exists-1 (17), the rules MP (14) and exists-E with its consequent and premise-dependency conditions (18), and Gen with the dependency-sensitive restriction 'x is not free in any premise of Gamma on which the derivation of phi depends; unrestricted when phi is derived from no premises' (19). The identity line (10) fixes dependency-annotated sequences, and lines 21-22 link the dependency sets to def:p02-hilbert-fol-dependencies (Gen clause at first-order-calculi-supplement.tex:68-70). The named system is unchanged and no old artifact is relied on.

The sheet itself (registry file lines 21-31, inside the same \showcalculus input) states the deduction theorem, Gamma u {phi} |- psi iff Gamma |- phi -> psi, and its free-variable condition: Gen and exists-E may be applied to a line whose support contains phi only when the rule's variable is not free in phi; an unrestricted generalization of a premise-dependent line is not an instance. It links Theorem thm:p02-hilbert-fol-deduction, Annex annex:p2.fol.calc.5 and Annex annex:p02-w02-p02-025-discharge, each defined once on route (off-route duplicates only in parts/p02/first-order-calculi.tex and annex/p02/first-order-calculi.tex). This closes the September record 'the sheet does not state/link the theorem'; the current registry file differs from the inventoried 19-line version.
